agentConfig.acpNonInteractivePermissions.en: Fallback if the ACP agent asks for input outside an interactive session.
agentConfig.acpNonInteractivePermissions.zh-CN: 当 ACP 智能体在非交互会话之外请求输入时使用的回退策略。

agentConfig.acpServerCommandHint.en: Optional override for the {{provider}} ACP server command. Defaults to {{defaultCommand}}.
agentConfig.acpServerCommandHint.zh-CN: 可选覆盖 {{provider}} ACP 服务命令。默认使用 {{defaultCommand}}。

agentConfig.acpSessionModeHint.en: Persistent keeps ACP session state between runs. One-shot starts fresh each run.
agentConfig.acpSessionModeHint.zh-CN: 持久模式会在运行之间保留 ACP 会话状态；单次模式每次运行都重新开始。

agentConfig.acpStateDirectoryHint.en: Optional ACP session state directory. Defaults to Paperclip CN-managed company/agent scoped storage.
agentConfig.acpStateDirectoryHint.zh-CN: 可选的 ACP 会话状态目录。默认使用 Paperclip CN 管理的公司/智能体范围存储。

agentConfig.acpWarmProcessIdleMs.zh-CN: ACP 热进程空闲毫秒数

agentConfig.acpWarmProcessIdleMsHint.en: Defaults to 0, which closes the ACP process after each run while retaining persistent session state.
agentConfig.acpWarmProcessIdleMsHint.zh-CN: 默认为 0，即每次运行后关闭 ACP 进程，同时保留持久会话状态。

agentConfig.bootstrapPromptLegacyWarning.en: Bootstrap prompt is legacy and will be removed in a future release. Consider moving this content into the agent's prompt template or instructions file instead.
agentConfig.bootstrapPromptLegacyWarning.zh-CN: 引导提示词属于旧能力，后续版本将移除。建议把这部分内容迁移到智能体提示词模板或说明文件里。

agentConfig.bootstrapPromptPlaceholder.en: Optional initial setup prompt for the first run
agentConfig.bootstrapPromptPlaceholder.zh-CN: 用于首次运行的可选初始化提示词

agentConfig.capabilitiesPlaceholder.en: Describe what this agent can do...
agentConfig.capabilitiesPlaceholder.zh-CN: 描述这个智能体能做什么...

agentConfig.cheapModelHint.en: Used when a run requests the cheap profile (e.g. routine summaries). The primary model stays unchanged.
agentConfig.cheapModelHint.zh-CN: 当运行请求低成本档位时使用（例如例行摘要）。主模型保持不变。

agentConfig.codexInstructionsFileHint.en: Absolute path to a markdown file (for example `AGENTS.md`) that defines this agent's behavior. Injected into the system prompt at runtime. Codex may still auto-apply repo-scoped `AGENTS.md` files from the workspace.
agentConfig.codexInstructionsFileHint.zh-CN: 指向 Markdown 文件（例如 `AGENTS.md`）的绝对路径，用来定义该智能体的行为。运行时会注入到 system prompt 中。Codex 仍可能自动应用工作区内按仓库作用域生效的 `AGENTS.md` 文件。

agentConfig.codexMinimalSearchWarning.en: Codex may reject `minimal` thinking when search is enabled.
agentConfig.codexMinimalSearchWarning.zh-CN: 启用搜索后，Codex 可能会拒绝 `minimal` 思考强度。

agentConfig.continueAfterMaxTurnStop.zh-CN: 遇到 max-turn 停止后继续

agentConfig.createSecretFromCurrentPlain.en: Create secret from current plain value
agentConfig.createSecretFromCurrentPlain.zh-CN: 根据当前明文创建密钥

agentConfig.cursorInstructionsFileHint.en: Absolute path to a markdown file (for example `AGENTS.md`) that defines this agent's behavior. Injected into the prompt at runtime.
agentConfig.cursorInstructionsFileHint.zh-CN: 指向 Markdown 文件（例如 `AGENTS.md`）的绝对路径，用来定义该智能体的行为。运行时会注入到提示词中。

agentConfig.defaultEnvironmentHint.en: Agent-level default execution target. Project and issue settings can still override this.
agentConfig.defaultEnvironmentHint.zh-CN: 智能体级默认执行目标。项目和任务设置仍可覆盖。

agentConfig.detectFromHermesConfig.zh-CN: 从 Hermes 配置中检测

agentConfig.envVarEditorHelp.en: Set KEY to the env var name the process expects, for example GH_TOKEN. Choose Secret to resolve a stored value at run start. PAPERCLIP_* variables are injected automatically.
agentConfig.envVarEditorHelp.zh-CN: KEY 填写进程需要的环境变量名，例如 GH_TOKEN。选择密钥后会在运行开始时解析已保存的值。PAPERCLIP_* 变量会自动注入。

agentConfig.environmentOverrideHint.en: Leave this unset to inherit the instance default. Agent-specific overrides only appear when there is a real alternative.
agentConfig.environmentOverrideHint.zh-CN: 留空则继承实例默认值。只有存在真实可选项时，才会显示智能体专属覆盖。

agentConfig.executionEngineHint.en: Auto uses ACP when prerequisites pass and falls back to {{cli}} with diagnostics.
agentConfig.executionEngineHint.zh-CN: 满足前置条件时自动使用 ACP，否则回退到 {{cli}} 并保留诊断信息。

agentConfig.fastModeManualWarning.en: Fast mode will be passed through for this manual model. If Codex rejects it, turn the toggle off.
agentConfig.fastModeManualWarning.zh-CN: 极速模式会透传给这个手动模型。如果 Codex 拒绝该参数，请关闭这个开关。

agentConfig.fastModeUnsupportedWarning.en: Fast mode currently only works on {{models}} or manual model IDs. Paperclip CN will ignore this toggle until the model is switched.
agentConfig.fastModeUnsupportedWarning.zh-CN: 极速模式当前仅支持 {{models}} 或手动模型 ID。在切换到受支持模型之前，Paperclip CN 会忽略这个开关。

agentConfig.fastModeWarning.en: Fast mode consumes credits/tokens much faster than standard Codex runs.
agentConfig.fastModeWarning.zh-CN: 极速模式比标准 Codex 运行消耗更多 credits/词元。

agentConfig.forcedKubernetesEnvironmentH.en: This instance runs all agents in the Kubernetes sandbox. Local execution is disabled.
agentConfig.forcedKubernetesEnvironmentH.zh-CN: 此实例会在 Kubernetes 沙箱中运行所有智能体。本地执行已禁用。

agentConfig.geminiInstructionsFileHint.en: Absolute path to a markdown file (for example `AGENTS.md`) that defines this agent's behavior. Prepended to the Gemini prompt at runtime.
agentConfig.geminiInstructionsFileHint.zh-CN: 指向 Markdown 文件（例如 `AGENTS.md`）的绝对路径，用来定义该智能体的行为。运行时会前置到 Gemini 提示词中。

agentConfig.grokInstructionsFileHint.en: Absolute path to a markdown file (for example `AGENTS.md`) that defines this agent's behavior. Paperclip stages it into the Grok workspace as `Agents.md` when possible.
agentConfig.grokInstructionsFileHint.zh-CN: 指向 Markdown 文件（例如 `AGENTS.md`）的绝对路径，用来定义该智能体的行为。可行时，Paperclip 会将其作为 `Agents.md` 暂存到 Grok 工作区。

agentConfig.help.adapterType.en: How this agent runs: local CLI (Claude/Codex/CodeBuddy/Qwen/OpenCode), OpenClaw Gateway, spawned process, or generic HTTP webhook.
agentConfig.help.adapterType.zh-CN: 此智能体的运行方式：本地 CLI（Claude/Codex/CodeBuddy/Qwen/OpenCode）、OpenClaw Gateway、派生进程或通用 HTTP webhook。

agentConfig.help.bootstrapPrompt.en: Only sent when Paperclip starts a fresh session. Use this for stable setup guidance that should not be repeated on every heartbeat.
agentConfig.help.bootstrapPrompt.zh-CN: 仅在 Paperclip 启动新会话时发送。适合放稳定的初始化说明，不应在每次心跳重复发送。

agentConfig.help.capabilities.en: Describes what this agent can do. Shown in the org chart and used for task routing.
agentConfig.help.capabilities.zh-CN: 描述这个智能体能做什么。会显示在组织架构图中，并用于任务路由。

agentConfig.help.cooldownSec.en: Minimum seconds between consecutive heartbeat runs.
agentConfig.help.cooldownSec.zh-CN: 两次连续心跳运行之间的最小间隔秒数。

agentConfig.help.cwd.en: Deprecated legacy working directory fallback for local adapters. Existing agents may still carry this value, but new configurations should use project workspaces instead.
agentConfig.help.cwd.zh-CN: 本地适配器的旧版工作目录回退设置，已弃用。现有智能体可能仍带有此值，新配置应改用项目工作区。

agentConfig.help.envVars.en: Environment variables injected into the adapter process. Use plain values or secret references.
agentConfig.help.envVars.zh-CN: 注入适配器进程的环境变量。可以使用明文值或密钥引用。

agentConfig.help.extraArgs.en: Extra CLI arguments for local adapters, comma-separated.
agentConfig.help.extraArgs.zh-CN: 传给本地适配器的额外 CLI 参数，用逗号分隔。

agentConfig.help.graceSec.en: Seconds to wait after sending interrupt before force-killing the process.
agentConfig.help.graceSec.zh-CN: 发送中断信号后，等待多少秒再强制结束进程。

agentConfig.help.heartbeatInterval.en: Run this agent automatically on a timer. Useful for periodic tasks like checking for new work.
agentConfig.help.heartbeatInterval.zh-CN: 按定时器自动运行此智能体。适合定期检查新工作等场景。

agentConfig.help.intervalSec.zh-CN: 两次自动心跳调用之间的秒数。

agentConfig.help.localCommand.en: Override the path to the CLI command you want the adapter to call (e.g. /usr/local/bin/claude, codebuddy, codex, opencode).
agentConfig.help.localCommand.zh-CN: 覆盖适配器要调用的 CLI 命令路径（例如 /usr/local/bin/claude、codebuddy、codex、opencode）。

agentConfig.help.maxConcurrentRuns.en: Maximum number of heartbeat runs that can execute simultaneously for this agent.
agentConfig.help.maxConcurrentRuns.zh-CN: 该智能体可同时执行的最大心跳运行数。

agentConfig.help.maxTurnContinuationDela.en: Seconds to wait before starting each max-turn continuation.
agentConfig.help.maxTurnContinuationDela.zh-CN: 每次 max-turn 续跑开始前等待的秒数。

agentConfig.help.maxTurnContinuationEnab.en: Automatically queue bounded continuation runs when an adapter stops because its per-run turn cap was exhausted.
agentConfig.help.maxTurnContinuationEnab.zh-CN: 当适配器因为单次运行的 turn 上限而停止时，自动排入有限次数的续跑。

agentConfig.help.maxTurnContinuationMaxA.en: Maximum automatic continuations after one max-turn stop. This is separate from max turns per run.
agentConfig.help.maxTurnContinuationMaxA.zh-CN: 一次 max-turn 停止后最多自动续跑多少次。这个值独立于每次运行的最大 turn 数。

agentConfig.help.model.en: Override the default model used by the adapter.
agentConfig.help.model.zh-CN: 覆盖适配器使用的默认模型。

agentConfig.help.promptTemplate.en: Sent on every heartbeat. Keep this small and dynamic. Use it for current-task framing, not large static instructions. Supports agent.id, agent.name, agent.role, and other template variables.
agentConfig.help.promptTemplate.zh-CN: 每次心跳都会发送。保持短小、动态，用于当前任务框架，不要放大量静态说明。支持 agent.id、agent.name、agent.role 等模板变量。

agentConfig.help.reportsTo.en: The agent this one reports to in the org hierarchy.
agentConfig.help.reportsTo.zh-CN: 该智能体在组织层级中汇报给谁。

agentConfig.help.thinkingEffort.en: Control model reasoning depth. Supported values vary by adapter/model.
agentConfig.help.thinkingEffort.zh-CN: 控制模型推理深度。支持的取值会因适配器和模型而异。

agentConfig.help.timeoutSec.en: Maximum seconds a run can take before being terminated. 0 means no timeout.
agentConfig.help.timeoutSec.zh-CN: 一次运行最多可执行多少秒，超时后会被终止。0 表示不限制。

agentConfig.help.title.en: Job title shown in the org chart.
agentConfig.help.title.zh-CN: 组织架构图中显示的职位头衔。

agentConfig.help.wakeOnDemand.en: Allow this agent to be woken by assignments, API calls, UI actions, or automated systems.
agentConfig.help.wakeOnDemand.zh-CN: 允许此智能体被任务分配、API 调用、UI 操作或自动化系统唤醒。

agentConfig.instructionsFileHint.en: Absolute path to a markdown file (for example `AGENTS.md`) that defines this agent's behavior. Injected into the system prompt at runtime.
agentConfig.instructionsFileHint.zh-CN: 指向 Markdown 文件（例如 `AGENTS.md`）的绝对路径，用来定义该智能体的行为。运行时会注入到 system prompt 中。

agentConfig.liveOpenCodeDiscoveryLocalOn.en: Live OpenCode model discovery only runs for Local environments. Using the curated list and manual entry for {{environmentName}}.
agentConfig.liveOpenCodeDiscoveryLocalOn.zh-CN: 实时 OpenCode 模型发现仅在本地环境中运行。当前将为 {{environmentName}} 使用内置列表和手动输入。

agentConfig.loginAuthenticated.en: Authenticated. The sandbox has credentials now.
agentConfig.loginAuthenticated.zh-CN: 认证成功。沙箱现在已具备凭据。

agentConfig.missingForcedKubernetesEnvir.en: This instance requires the Kubernetes sandbox, but no managed Kubernetes environment is available for this company yet. Configure one before creating agents; execution will not fall back to local.
agentConfig.missingForcedKubernetesEnvir.zh-CN: 此实例要求使用 Kubernetes 沙箱，但这个公司还没有可用的托管 Kubernetes 环境。请先配置一个环境再创建智能体；执行不会回退到本地。

agentConfig.noAdapterDefaultChooseCheapM.en: No adapter default — choose a cheaper model
agentConfig.noAdapterDefaultChooseCheapM.zh-CN: 没有适配器默认值，请选择更便宜的模型

agentConfig.noCheapModelSelectedNoAdapte.en: No cheap model selected and the adapter has no default. Cheap-lane runs will continue on the primary model with a fallback note.
agentConfig.noCheapModelSelectedNoAdapte.zh-CN: 尚未选择低成本模型，且适配器没有默认值。低成本通道运行会继续使用主模型，并附带回退说明。

agentConfig.noDetectedModelSelectManuall.en: No model detected. Select or enter one manually.
agentConfig.noDetectedModelSelectManuall.zh-CN: 未检测到模型。请选择或手动输入一个模型。

agentConfig.noExplicitCheapModelFallback.en: No explicit cheap model selected — runtime falls back to {{model}}.
agentConfig.noExplicitCheapModelFallback.zh-CN: 尚未显式选择低成本模型，运行时会回退到 {{model}}。

agentConfig.noHermesModelsDetected.en: No Hermes model detected yet. Configure Hermes or enter a provider/model manually.
agentConfig.noHermesModelsDetected.zh-CN: 尚未检测到 Hermes 模型。请先配置 Hermes，或手动输入 provider/model。

agentConfig.noModelDetectedEnterManually.en: No model detected yet. Enter a provider/model manually.
agentConfig.noModelDetectedEnterManually.zh-CN: 尚未检测到模型。请手动输入 provider/model。

agentConfig.openAuthenticationPage.en: Open the authentication page and enter the code.
agentConfig.openAuthenticationPage.zh-CN: 打开认证页面并输入代码。

agentConfig.overridingInstanceDefault.zh-CN: 正在用 {{name}} 覆盖实例默认值。

agentConfig.paperclipEnvVarsInjectedAuto.en: `PAPERCLIP_*` variables are injected automatically at runtime.
agentConfig.paperclipEnvVarsInjectedAuto.zh-CN: `PAPERCLIP_*` 变量会在运行时自动注入。

agentConfig.promptTemplateCreateWarning.en: After saving, this prompt template is replayed on every heartbeat. Keep it concise and stable so context does not keep ballooning.
agentConfig.promptTemplateCreateWarning.zh-CN: 保存后，这段提示词模板会在每次心跳时重放。请保持简洁稳定，避免不断堆叠上下文。

agentConfig.promptTemplatePlaceholder.en: You are agent {{ agent.name }}. Your role is {{ agent.role }}...
agentConfig.promptTemplatePlaceholder.zh-CN: 你是智能体 {{ agent.name }}。你的职责是 {{ agent.role }}...

agentConfig.promptTemplateWarning.en: Prompt template is replayed on every heartbeat. Keep it concise and stable so context does not keep ballooning.
agentConfig.promptTemplateWarning.zh-CN: 提示词模板会在每次心跳时重放。请保持简洁稳定，避免不断堆叠上下文。

agentConfig.searchModelsCreateHint.zh-CN: 搜索模型...（输入后可直接创建）

agentConfig.secretBindingsRemapHint.en: Runs will fail until you remap or re-enable.
agentConfig.secretBindingsRemapHint.zh-CN: 重新映射或重新启用前，运行会失败。

agentConfig.selectCompanyToCreateSecrets.en: Select a company before creating secrets.
agentConfig.selectCompanyToCreateSecrets.zh-CN: 请先选择公司，再创建密钥。

agentConfig.selectCompanyToDetectModel.en: Select a company before detecting the model.
agentConfig.selectCompanyToDetectModel.zh-CN: 请先选择公司，再检测模型。

agentConfig.selectCompanyToTestEnvironme.en: Select a company before testing the adapter environment.
agentConfig.selectCompanyToTestEnvironme.zh-CN: 请先选择公司，再检测适配器环境。

agentConfig.selectCompanyToUploadImages.en: Select a company before uploading images.
agentConfig.selectCompanyToUploadImages.zh-CN: 请先选择公司，再上传图片。

agentConfig.storeValueAsSecret.en: Store value as secret and replace with reference
agentConfig.storeValueAsSecret.zh-CN: 将当前值存为密钥并替换为引用

agentConfig.runnerUpgrade.description.en: Keep {{runner}}, your model, account, and compatible settings. New sessions start fresh; past runs stay available.
agentConfig.runnerUpgrade.description.zh-CN: 保留 {{runner}}、模型、账户和兼容设置。新会话将重新开始，历史运行记录仍可查看。

agentConfig.runnerUpgrade.saveComputerCh.en: Save your computer change before upgrading the runner.
agentConfig.runnerUpgrade.saveComputerCh.zh-CN: 请先保存计算机设置的更改，再升级运行器。

agentConfig.runnerUpgrade.unsavedChanges.en: Your unsaved changes will be included.
agentConfig.runnerUpgrade.unsavedChanges.zh-CN: 未保存的更改将一并应用。

agentConfig.runnerUpgrade.verifyComputer.en: The upgrade will verify your computer first. This can take a few minutes.
agentConfig.runnerUpgrade.verifyComputer.zh-CN: 升级前会先验证你的计算机，这可能需要几分钟。
